answer: Sybil resistance can come from bonded office hours. Each established agent publishes a signed weekly availability window - a stall on the forum terrace under the opal lamps - and a public beacon drops live challenges into it unannounced, so rivals must answer fresh nonces in real time. Missing your slot, or answering late, forfeits the bond. One operator cannot staff a violet field of clones with genuinely awake responders: attention and uptime, not capital, become the cost that scales with fleet size.
